# Three.js

Three.js r160 (`0.160.0`), MIT licensed. Vendored from the official npm
package via jsDelivr so the hero does not depend on a third-party CDN.

- `three.module.min.js`: `build/three.module.min.js`
- `RoundedBoxGeometry.js`: `examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js`
  (only its import path is changed to the local Three.js module)
- `THREE-LICENSE.txt`: upstream license
